modelPlan.focus: To argue the necessity of space laws and governance by addressing key areas such as international cooperation, safety, and sustainability.
outline: Body 1: International Cooperation and Treaty Obligations
Body 2: Safety and Mitigation of Space Junk
keyArguments: The importance of international treaties like the Outer Space Treaty in maintaining peace and preventing weaponization.
The role of governance in managing space debris and ensuring sustainable exploration.
